status: predetermined models fixed before encrypted benchmark evaluation

models.name: archive8h64
models.normalization_applies_to: entire original network output, including output bias

ldl.inertia_assessment: exact rational pivots, including exact zero tail
ldl.growth_bound_meaning: upper bound for norm_inf(F^T F) of stored real factor rows

residual_certificate.arithmetic: exact rational arithmetic on stored IEEE-754 binary64 coefficients
residual_certificate.target: Qint multiplied by exact binary64 scale
residual_certificate.domain: all real x with max_j abs(x_j) <= R
residual_certificate.bound: absolute quadratic coefficient error <= R^2 * residual_box_unit_upper
residual_certificate.excludes: CKKS encoding, encryption, arithmetic, rescaling and decryption error

spectral.arithmetic: exact Fraction arithmetic on stored IEEE-754 binary64 rows
spectral.bound: R^2 * residual_box_unit_upper for every real max(abs(x)) <= R
